'''''Starship and Pilot''''' was a publication that the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Bali Rayden/Legends|Bali Rayden]] wrote for. The publication issued quality control awards to [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers and the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] consistently received more awards than any other manufacturer.
